title: 第21章
content:
第3章《与339の初次见面》那天晚饭还没结束顾昀迟就离席了，顾培闻嘴上责备着，却没有强留，只让他别玩得太晚。饭后又闲聊了几分钟，给温然抽血的那位医生带着一份报告回到套房，交给顾培闻过目。顾培闻翻阅过后，点点头，接着对温然说：“后天开始就去昀迟那儿吧，到时候派车接你。”温然内心一派惨淡，还要尽力让自己的笑没有任何破绽：“好的，谢谢顾爷爷。”回去的路上，陈舒茴的心情看起来就像之前收到96。8%匹配度的报告单时一样好。“升到了97。5%。”她说，满意的，她将手按在温然肩上，“顾昀迟那边就交给你了，好好表现，别惹他生气。”温然想说顾昀迟在饭桌上好像就已经很生气了，但是陈舒茴的手按着他的肩，像温柔地鼓励着孩子下次考试要继续努力的妈妈，温然第一次得到这样的鼓励，于是他点点头，说好。肩上的手很快就收回去了，陈舒茴打开手机处理公务，温然看看她的侧脸，又低下头看自己绞在一起的十指。惴惴不安着还是到了后天，早上，温然提前收拾好书包等待，听到芳姨在花园里叫自己，他立即跑出门。一辆黑色私家车停在大门外，司机为他打开车门。樾庭，首都九大别墅区之一，在寸土寸金的内环线为富人开辟出一片极具舒适与私密性的领地。一眼望过去，温然只能看到花、树和流水——低得吓人的容积率。车子在一幢米白色别墅前停下，不好意思让司机开门，温然抢先下了车。司机便迈上人行道，帮温然打开那扇黑色花园门。“这是我的名片，有需要接送的话您可以随时联系我。”温然接下名片，朝他半鞠一躬：“谢谢，麻烦您了。”他往花园里走，一直走到大门前，没有贸然敲门，对着门上那块类似人脸识别的东西研究了一会儿。忽然，门内传来一道电子音：“人脸录入成功。”正迷茫着，大门咔一声自动弹开了，温然不太确定地握住把手，慢慢将门拉开。一道灰色玻璃墙隔断大门处与玄关，温然顺着往里走，背后却响起说话声：“你好，你看不见我吗？”按理说有钱人都很注意风水，怎么会第一次来顾昀迟家就撞鬼——温然惶然转身，看到门后杵着一只胖胖的金属柱形物体，半人高，没有脖子，圆圆的脑袋正面是一块屏幕，里头显示出蹙眉无辜的表情。温然自言自语：“……好高级的垃圾桶。”“愤怒！”无辜的表情瞬间转为生气，垃圾桶风一样地从温然身旁移过去，“你会为你的无知感到后悔的！”“对不起。”原来是个机器人，温然向它道歉，跟着它绕过玻璃墙。“好吧，宽容只是我众多优秀品质中最不起眼的一个。”机器人说，“请换鞋。”温然走过去在玄关的沙发上坐下，换拖鞋。机器人一直站在旁边，高傲的，又忍不住偷偷打量他——温然的发色偏棕，低头时露出安静的侧脸，睫毛很长，右眼下一颗小小的泪痣，唇色浅，那种淡淡的肉粉。干净，很漂亮，但与大部分omega身上偏弱气的漂亮又明显不太一样。砰，一条长腿从转角的墙后伸出来踹了机器人一脚。“垃圾桶。”顾昀迟的声音恹恹的，“咖啡。”“……”机器人露出一个隐忍的微笑，“这次我就当没听到，下次不可以再这么叫了哦。”扭头去了厨房。温然还坐在沙发上，仰头看顾昀迟，对方刚起床不久的样子，垂眼时尤其显得轻蔑不耐。目光相对间，温然逼迫自己主动问好：“早。”不出意外又被漠视了，顾昀迟嘴巴都懒得张，趿着拖鞋迈向客厅中央的下沉式沙发，皱着眉窝进去。机器人端着咖啡出来，一边给顾昀迟递过去，一边像猫头鹰一样把头往后转了180度看着温然，开始自我介绍：“尊敬的客人您好，我是CHM集团经十余年苦心研究，夜以继日、呕心沥血、砥砺奋进、不断突破、不断创新，最终成功研发的集安保、管家、心灵导师、金融理财、投资顾问、代办签证、手机维修、游戏陪练、四六级代考等多项功能于一体的交互式智能机器人，我的编号是BDH横杠339，你可以亲切地称呼我为339老师。”温然背着书包站在那里听它侃侃而谈了半天，问：“请问横杠是什么意思？”“……”339在屏幕上打出一串字，原来是：BDH-339。

顾昀迟好像不太喜欢喝热咖啡，一直在不耐烦地吹热气，等339吹完牛，才终于抿了一口。339深情注视着温然，用一种沧桑的语气：“你是少爷第一个带回家的omega。”噗——顾昀迟把那口咖啡吐回杯子里，面色不虞地问339：“没放糖？”“啊？我忘了，不好意思，这就给您重做。”339终于转回头看他，“其实糖固然香甜，但少爷您偶尔也可以品尝一番苦涩，毕竟人生百味。”顾昀迟言简意赅：“滚。”339闭上嘴滚去了厨房，这个气氛，温然很怕也被骂滚，于是默默退回玄关，重新在换鞋的沙发上坐下，从书包里拿出课本自学。老师到的时候顾昀迟正在餐厅吃早饭，温然站起来打招呼，老师问：“是温然吧？”她笑了下，“我先去书房备课，你和昀迟等会儿就上来吧。”“好的。”“老师——”339从餐厅那头转出来，贴到老师腿边，谄媚地说，“我给您开电梯门。”“谢谢339。”老师摸摸339光秃的脑袋，走进电梯。339又折回来，眨巴着电子大眼看温然，问：“你喜欢吃什么菜？我通知一下厨师，午饭的时候给你做。”“不用的，我回去吃。”“不行哦，董事长助理那边给我发了指令的，要你留在这里吃饭。”“……”温然只好说，“我不怎么挑食，随便什么菜都可以吧。”“好吧，我这里刚好有收到关于你的身体报告，我发给营养师，让他帮你搭配一下。”“会不会太麻烦了？”“不麻烦，他们每天闲得要死哈。”339面朝餐厅，放大音量，“顾大少爷！上课时间到了！请抓紧哦！”不一会儿，顾昀迟拉着脸走出来，穿过客厅走向电梯，339赶紧带着温然跟过去。电梯门自动打开，顾昀迟走进去，温然走进去，339也溜进去。电梯门关上，顾昀迟问：“你进来干什么？”温然一惊，还以为在质问自己，就听339答道：“保护温然！”神经病，顾昀迟不屑地冷嗤一声。339却跟等这一刻等了一辈子一样，立刻激动又惊喜地说：“少爷笑了……！少爷已经很久没有这样笑过了！”好疯狂的机器人，温然尴尬得快窒息了，幸好电梯门及时打开，顾昀迟迈步走出去，留给339无情的一句：“你活不过今晚。”“谁在乎。”339笑嘻嘻的，对走出电梯的温然说，“请努力学习吧！”书桌大得像双人床，温然和顾昀迟各坐一头。开始上课了温然才知道顾昀迟早已修完了高中课程，目前在做各类竞赛题和学习本科内容。温然看看那块电子黑板，几乎没什么能看懂的，他埋头做自己的题。老师只讲重点，将知识集中地过一遍，留给顾昀迟自己消化。一个多小时后，她来到温然这边，打开课本，老师微笑着，温柔地说：“字这么丑啊。”温然无地自容：“……确实。”“没关系，至少还是可以看懂的。”老师安慰他。这个学期的课程几乎都是靠上网课和自学，顶着顾昀迟大概会认为他是个蠢货的压力，温然向老师请教自己攒下的各种问题。

Chapter 3 "First Meeting with 339" Gu Yunchi left the dinner before dinner was over that day. Gu Peiwen scolded him, but did not force him to stay. He only asked him not to play too late.After chatting for a few more minutes after the meal, the doctor who drew Wen Ran's blood returned to the suite with a report and gave it to Gu Pei for review.After reading through it, Gu Peiwen nodded, and then said to Wen Ran: "Let's go to Yunchi's place starting the day after tomorrow, and we will send a car to pick you up." Wen Ran felt bleak in his heart, and tried his best to keep his smile flawless: "Okay, thank you, Grandpa Gu." On the way back, Chen Shuhui's mood seemed as good as when he received the 96.8% match report."It has risen to 97.5%." She said, satisfied, and put her hand on Wen Ran's shoulder, "Gu Yunchi will leave it to you, behave well and don't make him angry." Wen Ran wanted to say that Gu Yunchi seemed to be very angry at the dinner table, but Chen Shuhui's hand pressed his shoulder, like a mother gently encouraging her child to continue working hard in the next exam. It was the first time Wen Ran received such encouragement, so he nodded and said yes.The hand on the shoulder was quickly retracted. Chen Shuhui turned on her mobile phone to handle official business. Wen Ran looked at her side face, then lowered her head to look at her twisted fingers.Uneasy, the day after tomorrow arrived. In the morning, Wen Ran packed his schoolbag in advance and waited. When he heard Aunt Fang calling him in the garden, he ran out immediately.A black private car parked outside the gate, and the driver opened the door for him.Yueting, one of the nine major villa areas in the capital, has opened up a very comfortable and private territory for the wealthy in the inner ring road where land is at a premium.At a glance, Wen Ran could only see flowers, trees and running water - a shockingly low floor area ratio.The car stopped in front of an off-white villa. I was embarrassed to let the driver open the door, so Wen Ran got out of the car first.The driver stepped onto the sidewalk and helped Wen Ran open the black garden door."This is my business card. If you need transportation, you can contact me at any time." Wen Ran took the business card and gave him a half-bow: "Thank you, please." He walked into the garden and walked to the door. He did not knock on the door rashly and studied the facial recognition thing on the door for a while.Suddenly, an electronic sound came from the door: "Face registration successful." Just as he was confused, the door automatically opened with a click. Wen Ran held the handle uncertainly and slowly opened the door.A gray glass wall separated the door from the entrance. Wen Ran walked along, but a voice sounded from behind: "Hello, can't you see me?" It stands to reason that rich people pay attention to feng shui, so how could they encounter ghosts when they first came to Gu Yunchi's house? Wen Ran turned around in panic and saw a fat metal cylindrical object stuck behind the door. It was half a person tall and had no neck. There was a screen in front of its round head, which showed an innocent expression of frowning.Wen Ran said to himself: "...What a high-end trash can." "Angry!" The innocent expression turned to anger in an instant, and the trash can moved past Wen Ran like the wind, "You will regret your ignorance!" "I'm sorry." It turned out to be a robot. Wen Ran apologized to it and followed it around the glass wall."Well, tolerance is just the least noticeable of my many excellent qualities." The robot said, "Please change your shoes." Wen Ran walked over, sat down on the sofa in the entrance, and changed into slippers.The robot had been standing nearby, arrogant, but couldn't help but look at him secretly - Wen Ran's hair color was brown, and when he lowered his head, he showed a quiet profile, with long eyelashes, a small tear mole under his right eye, and light-colored lips, a light pink color.It's clean and very beautiful, but it's obviously not the same as most omegas who are pretty and weak.Bang, a long leg stretched out from behind the corner wall and kicked the robot."Trash can." Gu Yunchi's voice was weak, "Coffee." "..." The robot showed a forbearing smile, "I'll just pretend that I didn't hear it this time. I can't scream like that next time." He turned and went to the kitchen.Wen Ran was still sitting on the sofa, looking up at Gu Yunchi. He looked like he had just woken up, and when he lowered his eyes, he looked especially contemptuous and impatient.As their eyes met, Wen Ran forced himself to say hello: "Good morning." As expected, he was ignored again. Gu Yunchi didn't even bother to open his mouth. He walked towards the sunken sofa in the center of the living room with his slippers on, and went in with a frown.The robot came out with coffee, handed it to Gu Yun, and turned its head 180 degrees back like an owl to look at Wen Ran, and began to introduce himself: "Dear guest, I am the CHM Group. After more than ten years of painstaking research, day and night, painstaking efforts, forge ahead, continuous breakthroughs, and innovations, I finally successfully developed a comprehensive security, housekeeper, spiritual mentor, financial management, investment consultant, and agent.An interactive intelligent robot that has many functions including visa application, mobile phone repair, game training, and CET-4 and CET exams.My number is BDH 339. You can affectionately call me Teacher 339." Wen Ran stood there with his schoolbag on his back and listened to its talk for a long time, and asked: "What does the horizontal bar mean?" "..." 339 typed a string of words on the screen, and it turned out to be: BDH-339.

Gu Yunchi didn't seem to like drinking hot coffee, so he kept blowing hot air impatiently. He waited until 339 finished bragging before finally taking a sip.339 looked at Wen Ran affectionately, and said in a vicissitudes of tone: "You are the first omega that the young master brought home." Pfft - Gu Yunchi spit the coffee back into the cup, and asked 339 with a calm expression: "Didn't you put sugar in it?" "Ah? I forgot, I'm sorry, I'll make it again for you." 339 finally turned back to look at him,"Actually, sugar is sweet, but young master, you can also taste bitterness occasionally. After all, life is full of flavors." Gu Yunchi said concisely and concisely: "Get out." 339 closed his mouth and ran to the kitchen. In this atmosphere, Wen Ran was afraid of being scolded, so she silently returned to the entrance hall, sat down on the sofa where she was changing shoes, and took out the textbook from her schoolbag to study by herself.When the teacher arrived, Gu Yunchi was having breakfast in the restaurant. Wen Ran stood up to say hello. The teacher asked, "Is it Wen Ran?" She smiled, "I'll go to the study room to prepare lessons first. You and Yunchi will come up later." "Okay."Teacher -" 339 turned out from the restaurant and leaned against the teacher's leg, saying flatteringly, "I'll open the elevator door for you.""Thank you 339."The teacher touched 339's bald head and walked into the elevator.339 turned back again, blinked at Wen Ran with his big electronic eyes, and asked, "What kind of food do you like? I'll inform the chef and cook it for you at lunch." "No, I'll go back to eat." "No, the assistant to the chairman gave me an order, asking you to stay here to eat." "..." Wen Ran had to say, "I'm not very picky about food, any food is fine." "Okay, I'm here.I just received a report about your body. I'll send it to the nutritionist and ask him to help you adjust it."Isn't it too troublesome?"339 faced the restaurant and turned up the volume, "Master Gu! It's time for class!"After a while, Gu Yunchi walked out with a face and walked to the elevator, and 339 quickly followed him.The elevator door opened automatically, Gu Yunchi walked in, Wen Ran walked in, and 339 also slipped in.When the elevator door closed, Gu Yunchi asked: "What did you come in for?" Wen Ran was startled, thinking that he was questioning himself, and then heard 339 reply: "Protect Wen Ran!" Gu Yunchi sneered disdainfully because of his lunacy.However, as if he had been waiting for this moment all his life, 339 immediately said with excitement and surprise: "The young master smiled...! The young master has not laughed like this for a long time!" What a crazy robot, Wen Ran almost suffocated with embarrassment. Fortunately, the elevator door opened in time, and Gu YunChi stepped out and left 339 with a ruthless sentence: "You won't survive tonight." "Who cares." 339 smiled and said to Wen Ran who walked out of the elevator, "Please study hard!" The desk was as big as a double bed, and Wen Ran and Gu Yunchi sat at each end.When class started, Wen Ran learned that Gu Yun had already completed high school courses and was currently doing various competition questions and studying undergraduate content.Wen Ran looked at the electronic blackboard. There was almost nothing he could understand. He concentrated on his own questions.The teacher only talked about the key points and went through the knowledge in a concentrated manner, leaving it to Gu Yunchi to digest it himself.More than an hour later, she came to Wen Ran and opened the textbook. The teacher smiled and said softly: "The handwriting is so ugly." Wen Ran was ashamed: "... Indeed." "It doesn't matter, at least it can be understood." The teacher comforted him.This semester's courses were almost all based on online classes and self-study. Against the pressure of Gu Yunchi who might think he was an idiot, Wen Ran asked the teacher for help on various questions he had saved up.

第3章《与339の初次见面》那天晚饭还没结束顾昀迟就离席了，顾培闻嘴上责备着，却没有强留，只让他别玩得太晚。饭后又闲聊了几分钟，给温然抽血的那位医生带着一份报告回到套房，交给顾培闻过目。顾培闻翻阅过后，点点头，接着对温然说：“后天开始就去昀迟那儿吧，到时候派车接你。”温然内心一派惨淡，还要尽力让自己的笑没有任何破绽：“好的，谢谢顾爷爷。”回去的路上，陈舒茴的心情看起来就像之前收到96。8%匹配度的报告单时一样好。“升到了97。5%。”她说，满意的，她将手按在温然肩上，“顾昀迟那边就交给你了，好好表现，别惹他生气。”温然想说顾昀迟在饭桌上好像就已经很生气了，但是陈舒茴的手按着他的肩，像温柔地鼓励着孩子下次考试要继续努力的妈妈，温然第一次得到这样的鼓励，于是他点点头，说好。肩上的手很快就收回去了，陈舒茴打开手机处理公务，温然看看她的侧脸，又低下头看自己绞在一起的十指。惴惴不安着还是到了后天，早上，温然提前收拾好书包等待，听到芳姨在花园里叫自己，他立即跑出门。一辆黑色私家车停在大门外，司机为他打开车门。樾庭，首都九大别墅区之一，在寸土寸金的内环线为富人开辟出一片极具舒适与私密性的领地。一眼望过去，温然只能看到花、树和流水——低得吓人的容积率。车子在一幢米白色别墅前停下，不好意思让司机开门，温然抢先下了车。司机便迈上人行道，帮温然打开那扇黑色花园门。“这是我的名片，有需要接送的话您可以随时联系我。”温然接下名片，朝他半鞠一躬：“谢谢，麻烦您了。”他往花园里走，一直走到大门前，没有贸然敲门，对着门上那块类似人脸识别的东西研究了一会儿。忽然，门内传来一道电子音：“人脸录入成功。”正迷茫着，大门咔一声自动弹开了，温然不太确定地握住把手，慢慢将门拉开。一道灰色玻璃墙隔断大门处与玄关，温然顺着往里走，背后却响起说话声：“你好，你看不见我吗？”按理说有钱人都很注意风水，怎么会第一次来顾昀迟家就撞鬼——温然惶然转身，看到门后杵着一只胖胖的金属柱形物体，半人高，没有脖子，圆圆的脑袋正面是一块屏幕，里头显示出蹙眉无辜的表情。温然自言自语：“……好高级的垃圾桶。”“愤怒！”无辜的表情瞬间转为生气，垃圾桶风一样地从温然身旁移过去，“你会为你的无知感到后悔的！”“对不起。”原来是个机器人，温然向它道歉，跟着它绕过玻璃墙。“好吧，宽容只是我众多优秀品质中最不起眼的一个。”机器人说，“请换鞋。”温然走过去在玄关的沙发上坐下，换拖鞋。机器人一直站在旁边，高傲的，又忍不住偷偷打量他——温然的发色偏棕，低头时露出安静的侧脸，睫毛很长，右眼下一颗小小的泪痣，唇色浅，那种淡淡的肉粉。干净，很漂亮，但与大部分omega身上偏弱气的漂亮又明显不太一样。砰，一条长腿从转角的墙后伸出来踹了机器人一脚。“垃圾桶。”顾昀迟的声音恹恹的，“咖啡。”“……”机器人露出一个隐忍的微笑，“这次我就当没听到，下次不可以再这么叫了哦。”扭头去了厨房。温然还坐在沙发上，仰头看顾昀迟，对方刚起床不久的样子，垂眼时尤其显得轻蔑不耐。目光相对间，温然逼迫自己主动问好：“早。”不出意外又被漠视了，顾昀迟嘴巴都懒得张，趿着拖鞋迈向客厅中央的下沉式沙发，皱着眉窝进去。机器人端着咖啡出来，一边给顾昀迟递过去，一边像猫头鹰一样把头往后转了180度看着温然，开始自我介绍：“尊敬的客人您好，我是CHM集团经十余年苦心研究，夜以继日、呕心沥血、砥砺奋进、不断突破、不断创新，最终成功研发的集安保、管家、心灵导师、金融理财、投资顾问、代办签证、手机维修、游戏陪练、四六级代考等多项功能于一体的交互式智能机器人，我的编号是BDH横杠339，你可以亲切地称呼我为339老师。”温然背着书包站在那里听它侃侃而谈了半天，问：“请问横杠是什么意思？”“……”339在屏幕上打出一串字，原来是：BDH-339。

顾昀迟好像不太喜欢喝热咖啡，一直在不耐烦地吹热气，等339吹完牛，才终于抿了一口。339深情注视着温然，用一种沧桑的语气：“你是少爷第一个带回家的omega。”噗——顾昀迟把那口咖啡吐回杯子里，面色不虞地问339：“没放糖？”“啊？我忘了，不好意思，这就给您重做。”339终于转回头看他，“其实糖固然香甜，但少爷您偶尔也可以品尝一番苦涩，毕竟人生百味。”顾昀迟言简意赅：“滚。”339闭上嘴滚去了厨房，这个气氛，温然很怕也被骂滚，于是默默退回玄关，重新在换鞋的沙发上坐下，从书包里拿出课本自学。老师到的时候顾昀迟正在餐厅吃早饭，温然站起来打招呼，老师问：“是温然吧？”她笑了下，“我先去书房备课，你和昀迟等会儿就上来吧。”“好的。”“老师——”339从餐厅那头转出来，贴到老师腿边，谄媚地说，“我给您开电梯门。”“谢谢339。”老师摸摸339光秃的脑袋，走进电梯。339又折回来，眨巴着电子大眼看温然，问：“你喜欢吃什么菜？我通知一下厨师，午饭的时候给你做。”“不用的，我回去吃。”“不行哦，董事长助理那边给我发了指令的，要你留在这里吃饭。”“……”温然只好说，“我不怎么挑食，随便什么菜都可以吧。”“好吧，我这里刚好有收到关于你的身体报告，我发给营养师，让他帮你搭配一下。”“会不会太麻烦了？”“不麻烦，他们每天闲得要死哈。”339面朝餐厅，放大音量，“顾大少爷！上课时间到了！请抓紧哦！”不一会儿，顾昀迟拉着脸走出来，穿过客厅走向电梯，339赶紧带着温然跟过去。电梯门自动打开，顾昀迟走进去，温然走进去，339也溜进去。电梯门关上，顾昀迟问：“你进来干什么？”温然一惊，还以为在质问自己，就听339答道：“保护温然！”神经病，顾昀迟不屑地冷嗤一声。339却跟等这一刻等了一辈子一样，立刻激动又惊喜地说：“少爷笑了……！少爷已经很久没有这样笑过了！”好疯狂的机器人，温然尴尬得快窒息了，幸好电梯门及时打开，顾昀迟迈步走出去，留给339无情的一句：“你活不过今晚。”“谁在乎。”339笑嘻嘻的，对走出电梯的温然说，“请努力学习吧！”书桌大得像双人床，温然和顾昀迟各坐一头。开始上课了温然才知道顾昀迟早已修完了高中课程，目前在做各类竞赛题和学习本科内容。温然看看那块电子黑板，几乎没什么能看懂的，他埋头做自己的题。老师只讲重点，将知识集中地过一遍，留给顾昀迟自己消化。一个多小时后，她来到温然这边，打开课本，老师微笑着，温柔地说：“字这么丑啊。”温然无地自容：“……确实。”“没关系，至少还是可以看懂的。”老师安慰他。这个学期的课程几乎都是靠上网课和自学，顶着顾昀迟大概会认为他是个蠢货的压力，温然向老师请教自己攒下的各种问题。
